description: Command-line Registry Explorer: batch-file driven extraction and searching of registry hives.
usage: Runs batch files of registry queries against offline hives, or searches keys and values, and writes the results to CSV. Use it to extract many artifacts from the registry in one repeatable pass.
limitation: Reports only what the batch file asks for. Dirty hives need their transaction logs applied first.

parameters.label: Hive
parameters.description: Hive to search. -f or -d is required.

parameters.label: Hive directory
parameters.description: Directory to look for hives (recursively). -f or -d is required.

parameters.label: Batch file
parameters.description: Use settings from the supplied batch file to find keys/values (see the BatchExamples folder, e.g. Kroll_Batch.reb).

parameters.label: Key name
parameters.description: Display details for key name. Includes subkeys and values.

parameters.label: Value name
parameters.description: Value name. Only this value will be dumped.

parameters.label: Save value data to
parameters.description: Saves --vn value data in binary form to file. Expects path to a FILE.

parameters.label: Details
parameters.description: Show more details when displaying results.

parameters.label: Find Base64 (min bytes)
parameters.description: Find Base64 encoded values with size >= Base64 (specified in bytes).

parameters.label: Find values >= size
parameters.description: Find values with data size >= MinSize (specified in bytes).

parameters.label: Search all
parameters.description: Search for string in keys, values, data, and slack.

parameters.label: Search key names
parameters.description: Search for string in value record's key names.

parameters.label: Search value names
parameters.description: Search for string in value record's value names.

parameters.label: Search value data
parameters.description: Search for string in value record's value data.

parameters.label: Search value slack
parameters.description: Search for string in value record's value slack.

parameters.label: Literal search
parameters.description: --sd and --ss search value will not be interpreted as ASCII or Unicode byte strings.

parameters.label: No data
parameters.description: Do not show data when using --sd or --ss.

parameters.label: Regex search
parameters.description: Treat the string in --sk, --sv, --sd, and --ss as a regular expression.
Download the latest batch files from https://github.com/EricZimmerman/RECmd and update local files.
